_README: Copy this file to ecudefs/<maker>-<family>[-<variant>].json, set every field, and set id to the same name (minus .json). Directory scans skip TEMPLATE.json, so it never ships as a real ECU. JSON has no comments - every field starting with _ is a hint and MUST be deleted from your real definition. Validate with: opentune ecudefs validate ecudefs/<your-file>.json  (add --image <your-stock-dump> to check map addresses). See docs/CONTRIBUTING-ECUDEFS.md, docs/ECU-DEFS.md, docs/MAP-DEFS.md and docs/ecudef.schema.json.
name: Example ECU (template - rename me)
_notes_provenance: provenance is required: sources = one citation per source (a standard by name; an open project with path/commit and its licence; or 'own read' / 'own capture' - your own data is never committed). license = SPDX id the data is shipped under (normally GPL-3.0-or-later; no proprietary / non-commercial / unknown). evidence = implemented | synthetic-tested | real-image-tested | bench-tested | vehicle-tested (docs/DEVELOPMENT.md section 7) - never claim more than you have done.

sources: own stock read of the ECU (never committed): checksum round-trip and map decode

notes: Describe the ECU with PUBLIC family-level facts only. State clearly that addresses/flash_size are placeholders to be confirmed per software variant, and cite how you validated the checksum (e.g. 'opentune checksum verify --algo <id> reports all blocks OK on my own stock read'). Never ship proprietary firmware, A2L/DAMOS, seed/key secrets, real VINs or plates.
_notes_protocol: protocol: iso_tp | vwtp20 | iso14230_kline | iso9141 | raw_can. diag_layer: uds | kwp2000. full_read: obd | bench_boot.
_notes_numbers: All numbers are DECIMAL byte values/offsets - convert hex yourself (0x80000 -> 524288). flash_size is the size of the image the maps index (the full read).
_notes_checksum: checksum must be an id opentune-checksum knows (opentune checksum algos) or null: crc32-tail, edc15c6, edc16, edc17, pcr21, me7, dq250, dq381, tcu-ccitt. seedkey: usually null.
_notes_identify: Shortest part/software prefixes that are still specific to this family. Matched case/space-insensitively by prefix or substring against the ECU's reported HW/SW numbers.
_notes_maps: Optional. A definition with no maps is valid (identify + checksum still work); add diff-confirmed maps in follow-up PRs. EVERY map's notes MUST carry a confidence label: 'CONFIDENCE: HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW' (with source) or 'EXAMPLE ONLY'. rows=Y, cols=X; axis count must equal the map's size on that dimension; stored axes must be monotonic; give every map a unit.

maps.name: example 2-D map (rename / replace)
maps.notes: EXAMPLE ONLY. Placeholder address/axes; confirm per software variant before any read or write. Replace this map or delete the maps array entirely.
